descriptionByLocale.it:
Per sviluppare ulteriormente il nostro sito di produzione, stiamo cercando un ingegnere di processo dedicato (m/f/d) che forma attivamente il cambiamento da un produttore ad una produzione di ciclo efficiente e standardizzata. I vostri compiti in dettaglio:
• Analisi, valutazione e ottimizzazione dei processi aziendali già esistenti, con particolare attenzione all'efficienza, alla qualità e alla scalabilità, nonché all'individuazione delle vulnerabilità di processo e all'implementazione di misure di miglioramento sostenibili
• Ridisegnare e specificare i processi e le interfacce di processo in base a requisiti rilevanti come ISO9001, AQAP2110, oltre a introdurre e stabilire standard e best practice (ad es. metodi magra)
• Promuovere una stretta cooperazione, in particolare nelle interfacce a valore aggiunto (ad esempio produzione, assemblaggio, sviluppo, project management e logistica)
• Elaborazione indipendente di soluzioni per un trasferimento di strutture coltivate da una fabbricazione in una struttura a ciclo o ciclo strutturato. Produzione di piccole serie
• Pulire, standardizzare e aggiornare la documentazione di processo esistente e le istruzioni di lavoro in coordinamento con le interfacce
• Creazione di processi e documenti di accompagnamento nel sistema di gestione dei processi
• Definizione e preparazione dei materiali di formazione
• Formazione di dipendenti e interfacce in nuovi processi e standard
• Esperienza professionale nel settore metalmeccanico, manutenzione, produzione o ambiente simile
• Studi completi in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria della produzione o ingegneria industriale
• Ulteriore addestramento come ingegnere di processo (m/f/d) o simile vantaggio
• Diversi anni di esperienza nella produzione, idealmente nelle industrie regolamentate (ad esempio aerospaziale, difesa o automotive)
• Conoscenza della gestione della qualità ISO9001 o superiore, diversi anni di esperienza preferita
• Conoscenza approfondita nell'ottimizzazione dei processi, nella gestione magra e nell'ingegneria industriale
• Gestione sicura della documentazione tecnica e degli standard nonché metodi di lavoro strutturati, analitici e orientati alla soluzione
• Forza di assertività, forti capacità di comunicazione e buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con progetti emozionanti
• Ore lavorative flessibili (ore lavorative attive e affidabili)

descriptionByLocale.en:
To further develop our production site, we are looking for a dedicated process engineer (m/f/d) who actively shapes the change from a manufacturer to an efficient, standardized cycle production. Your tasks in detail:
• Analysis, evaluation and optimization of existing company-relevant processes with focus on efficiency, quality and scalability as well as identifying process vulnerabilities and implementing sustainable improvement measures
• Redesigning and specifying process processes and interfaces according to relevant requirements such as ISO9001, AQAP2110 as well as introducing and establishing standards and best practices (e.g. lean methods)
• Promoting close cooperation, particularly in value-added interfaces (e.g. production, assembly, development, project management and logistics)
• Independent elaboration of solutions for a transfer of grown structures from a manufacture into a structured cycle or cycle structure. Production of small series
• Clean up, standardise and update existing process documentation and work instructions in coordination with interfaces
• Creation of processes and accompanying documents in the process management system
• Definition and preparation of training materials
• Training of employees and interfaces in new processes and standards WHAT YOU SHOULD TEACH
• Professional experience in the metalworking industry, maintenance, manufacturing or similar environment
• Completed studies in mechanical engineering, production engineering or industrial engineering
• Further training as process engineer (m/f/d) or comparable advantageous
• Several years of experience in production, ideally in regulated industries (e.g. aerospace, defense or automotive)
• Knowledge of quality management ISO9001 or higher, several years of experience preferred
• In-depth knowledge in process optimization, lean management and industrial engineering
• Safe handling of technical documentation and standards as well as structured, analytical and solution-oriented working methods
• Strength of assertiveness, strong communication skills and very good knowledge of German and English WHAT WE ARE TO YOU
• A dynamic working environment with exciting projects
• Flexible working hours (active and trusted working hours)

As a production planner (m/f/d) for electronics production, you are responsible for planning our manufacturing processes in the area of SMD and THT assembly of electronic assemblies. Specifically, you take on the following tasks:
• Independent planning of production orders in the respective production area
• Scheduling and capacity planning taking into account material availability and capacities at the respective workplaces
• Ensuring on-time production of production orders
• Participation in regular matching and exchange dates with the fine control in production as well as the upstream and downstream areas in production as well as material management and project management operations
• Master data maintenance WHAT YOU SHOULD BUILD
• Completed technical apprenticeship, e.g. in the field of electronics or mechatronics as well as further training as a technician HF (m/f/d) or comparable
• Experience in electronics manufacturing (SMD and/or THT equipment)
• Knowledge of methodological competence and lean management
• Good application knowledge in SAP, WayRTS/MES and MS Office
• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing WHAT WE ARE TO YOU
• A dynamic working environment with exciting projects
• Flexible working hours (active and trusted working hours)
• Very good social benefits and a super-compulsory pension fund
• Employee benefits of a large corporation, employee share purchase program
• Promotion of needs-based training
• Staff restaurant and external catering and shopping facilities nearby
• Individual internal and external personnel development measures in cooperation with our Rheinmetall Academy
• Workplace a few minutes walk from the Zurich-Oerlikon train station KONTAKTDETAILS Responsible contact: Melanie Huellen For questions about your application, please use the contact form. Please note that dossiers of recruiters are not considered.
